adds.title: High Court of Justice filing July 2019 challenging Sexual Offences Act
adds.summary: On 19 July 2019 a case filed in Dominica's High Court challenged Sexual Offences Act section 14 criminalizing gross indecency defined as any non-penile-vaginal sexual use of the genital organs, breast or anus punishable by up to 12 years and section 16 criminalizing buggery defined as anal sex punishable by up to 10 years plus possible forced psychiatric confinement as violating constitutional rights and exposing LGBT persons including trans persons to criminal sanction for consensual activity and to discrimination, threats, harassment, violence and police discrimination and inaction.
